description: >
  Bring up the OARbot platform with a teleoperation interface and
  collect the demonstration dataset (LeRobot format) that the policy
  learning initiative trains on.
---

This track turns OARbot into a data-collection instrument. It covers
hardware/software bring-up of the robot, a teleoperation interface for
human demonstrations, camera and proprioception streams, and the
recording pipeline that lands demonstrations in LeRobot dataset format.
The deliverable is a curated demonstration dataset for the complex-task
suite defined in the Foundations initiative — the raw material every
policy in the Policy Learning initiative is trained from.
